coordinates.locator: midpoint of the centroids of the MapCERN building outlines of EHN1 (building 887) and EHN2 (building 888), the two surface experimental halls of the SPS North Area
coordinates.note: A campus-grade point for the SPS North Area experimental-hall zone (400 m precision): the midpoint between the EHN1 and EHN2 building outlines in CERN's own GIS layer, about 260 m from each. It is used for North Area experiments whose hall no fetched source names (NA50, NA60, NA45/CERES, NA57; "NA" is the CERN designation for North Area experiments) and is not a hall position. Refine when a source names the hall (EHN1 and EHN2 have their own site records).

summary.plain: CERN's Prévessin site on the French side of the border, where the SPS North Area experimental halls are located; a general location used for historical North Area experiments whose exact hall is not documented.
summary.technical: Campus-grade location for the CERN Prévessin site (SPS North Area): used for North Area heavy-ion experiments whose experimental hall is not identified in the sources fetched.

technical: Campus-grade location for the SPS North Area experimental-hall zone at Prévessin: the midpoint of the EHN1 and EHN2 building outlines in CERN's MapCERN layer; used for North Area heavy-ion experiments whose hall is not identified in the sources fetched.
